current_sources: working tree (HEAD is not the implementation identity)

numerical_contract.baseline: bitwise same-contract output and every final State; not full-vs-continuation bitwise

resource_notes: Default 1 GiB Target cap unchanged on both variants.
All baseline private modules loaded with git-show source and linecache; current public IR/validation unchanged and shared.
CUDA-event and CPU wall are separate single-invocation samples; CPU wall includes public call plus device synchronization, not event overhead.
Public samples interleaved with rotating order, graph pools isolated sequentially; peaks always before graph capture.
Regression threshold 5% median of original and two repeated public-event batches; original raw regressions retained.
Graph/kernel metrics do not substitute public geomean; full-matrix target is >=20% public reduction.
No FLA imports/invocations; independent oracle only in boundaries mode.
GPU safety preflight is the caller's responsibility; this script requires exactly one visible device.
